metadata.title: Secure‑Resilience Integration SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan specializing Secure‑Resilience for integration, messaging, and event‑driven systems where partial irreversibility and amplification risk are prevalent.

import-profile.remarks: This SSPP inherits Secure‑Resilience Platform semantics and specializes them for integration and communication systems.

system-characteristics.system-description: Integration systems include APIs, message brokers, event streams, workflows, and orchestration layers that propagate effects across domains. This SSPP emphasizes cautious replay, bounded redrive, and explicit compensation due to high amplification and partial irreversibility risks.

props.name: domain
props.remarks: Applies to all message‑based, API‑based, and workflow systems.

props.name: state-assumption
props.remarks: Integration state is assumed partially irreversible due to downstream side effects.

props.name: primary-risk
props.remarks: Message replay and resumption may multiply effects or violate real‑world constraints.

props.name: preferred-resilience-outcome
props.remarks: Halt or constrained processing is preferred over replay or redrive unless explicitly eligible.

props.name: implicit-replay
props.remarks: Message replay, redrive, or workflow restart must not be automatic.

props.name: automation-constraint
props.remarks: Automation must not infer continuation or replay from transport availability.

system-implementation.remarks: Integration resilience is implemented through strict gating of replay, redrive, compensation, and resumption actions based on Secure‑Resilience semantics and downstream impact awareness.

components.title: Integration Core
components.remarks: Integration execution semantics define delivery, amplification boundaries, and non‑equivalence between receipt and authorization.

components.title: Integration Command & Control
components.remarks: Replay and redrive are treated as command re‑issuance and are subject to resilience eligibility.

roles.title: Integration Resilience Architecture
roles.remarks: Defines replay, redrive, compensation, and halt semantics for integration systems.

roles.title: Integration Resilience Governance
roles.remarks: Approves eligibility rules for replay, compensation, and restart under disruption.

roles.title: Integration Resilience Operations
roles.remarks: Operates integration platforms and messaging systems under strict replay and resume constraints.

roles.title: Integration Resilience Monitoring
roles.remarks: Detects unsafe replay attempts, amplification risk, and resume violations.

control-implementation.remarks: Integration resilience relies on Secure‑Resilience constraints applied to NIST SP 800‑53 CP family controls and Secure‑Integration non‑equivalence semantics. This SSPP introduces no new control requirements.
